# moq_recordings (Data Source)

Lists a project's recordings, excluding those being deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "moq_recordings" "example" {
  project_id = moq_project.example.id
}

output "playlists" {
  value = [for r in data.moq_recordings.example.recordings : r.playlist_url if r.status == "ENDED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project's immutable ID.

### Read-Only

- `recordings` (Attributes List) The project's recordings, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recordings))

<a id="nestedatt--recordings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recordings`

Read-Only:

- `broadcast_path` (String) Broadcast path relative to the project.
- `bytes` (Number) Recorded media bytes.
- `duration_ms` (Number) Recorded media duration in milliseconds.
- `ended_at` (String) End time, RFC 3339, or null while live.
- `id` (String) Recording ID.
- `playlist_url` (String) Playback playlist URL, or null until media is ready.
- `started_at` (String) Start time, RFC 3339.
- `status` (String) `LIVE` while ingesting, then `ENDED`.
